items.summary: Co-developed with Meta's PyTorch team and announced at PyTorch Conference 2026, v0.2.0 ships under Apache 2.0 with four repos (TorchTPU, vLLM-TorchTPU, SGLang-TorchTPU, TorchTitan), tested from TPU v5e up to 8,192 Ironwood chips; Google reports 52% MFU training Qwen 3 8B, a fine-tuning step cut from 11.49s to 2.78s and 3.80x from torch.compile, with ~5,000 Hugging Face models under continuous test. Google says it replaces PyTorch/XLA for new workloads — landing one day after [[2026-10-20#1|AWS made Trainium a native PyTorch device]], so the two largest non-NVIDIA accelerator families now both take unmodified PyTorch.
items.title: Google open-sources TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Cloud TPUs

items.summary: MemTensor's architecture embeds continuous memory into the forward pass via Gated DeltaNet-2 with token-level memory updates and a Mixture-of-Storage design, trained in two stages on 34B tokens; two models are released (Nano ~35B, Flash ~288B). At a 128K-token history the authors report ~1.86x end-to-end inference speedup and a 66x reduction in persistent storage against a full-context KV cache, beating parametric-memory baselines and staying competitive with retrieval. A different attack on the same cost problem as [[2026-10-20#5|CarryOn's reusable task objects]].
items.title: MemT-1.0 puts memory inside the model, cutting persistent storage 66x

items.summary: A Chinese-speaking attacker ran a campaign against the websites of more than 100 companies with AI agents doing most of the work and minimal human involvement, at a reported cost of a few thousand dollars. Separately, GMO Internet Group's security arm attributes roughly 80 intrusions at Japanese firms, with 8 confirmed data leaks, to a Chinese AI pentest tool called ARTEX — two independent reports in one day that the cost of a competent intrusion campaign has collapsed.
items.title: Reuters: one hacker used AI agents and a few thousand dollars to breach 100+ company sites

items.summary: Meta's engineering post describes the Ohio build as a single-site gigawatt-class cluster aimed at roughly a million GPUs, and says it is what trains the Muse model family — including [[2026-10-16#0|Muse Spark Open]]. It is the first first-party technical account of a single-site cluster at that scale.
items.title: Meta details Prometheus, a gigawatt-scale supercluster targeting 1M GPUs on one site

items.summary: The WSJ reports the preliminary filing shows $16.3B of H1 2026 revenue, an $80.7B net loss driven largely by non-cash financing charges, about 25% of revenue from two unnamed customers with no long-term contracts, and committed compute of roughly $518B rising to as much as $750B including deals under negotiation; a November listing at around $2T is reported. That target sits above [[2026-10-17#10|the $1.5T some investors pushed for last week]] and restates the figures first seen in [[2026-09-29#4|the earlier prospectus]], against which [[2026-10-20#3|5% of shares were just pledged to the Public Benefit Fund]].
items.title: Anthropic's draft S-1: $16.3B first-half revenue against an $80.7B net loss

items.summary: The Apache-2.0 engine targets DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and supports both NVIDIA SM100 and Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs. Shipping a serving stack that runs on domestic silicon is the software half of [[2026-10-20#10|the plan to pre-train on Huawei's Ascend 950DT]], and it keeps DeepSeek deployable outside US hardware as [[2026-10-20#2|US civilian agencies strip its models out]].
items.title: DeepSeek open-sources DeepInfer, an inference engine for NVIDIA and Huawei NPUs

items.summary: The release covers speech recognition across more than 50 languages plus a text-to-speech model, with Mistral claiming it beats Whisper and other incumbents. No independent benchmark confirmation yet.
items.title: Mistral ships Voxtral 3 with transcription variants and a 50+ language TTS model

items.summary: The service runs periodic vulnerability scans on critical open-source repositories and can return proof-of-concept exploits and proposed patches at no cost. It operationalises [[2026-10-07#2|the three-tier cyber verification programme]] on code nobody is paid to defend — the other side of the remediation bill seen when [[2026-10-17#13|Bank of America hired 1,000 contractors to patch model-found flaws]].
items.title: Anthropic launches a free OSS Scanner for critical open-source projects

items.summary: The firm expects roughly 50GW delivered next year with a further 60GW already under construction, calling 2027 the year of acceleration. The forecast assumes the concrete lands on schedule, which it has not always — see [[2026-10-17#11|Nscale's six-month Arctic delay]].
items.title: SemiAnalysis forecasts ~50GW of new data centre capacity in 2027

items.summary: Internal ARCYBER documents obtained by The Intercept describe a programme developing autonomous agents for offensive cyber operations that act with little human supervision. It is a national military moving in the opposite direction from [[2026-09-28#1|the human-review language the US and Russia stripped from the UN autonomous-weapons draft]].
items.title: The Intercept: US Army's ECHOTRIBBLE builds offensive AI agents with minimal human oversight

items.summary: Mind Lab researchers use LoRA adapters plus a lightweight readout to fine-tune pretrained multimodal models for brain encoding, predicting multiple timepoints in one pass instead of sliding windows; the method improves encoding across nine backbones, scales to 104B parameters — the largest model adapted for the task to the authors' knowledge — and an ensemble of 200+ adapted models topped the public Algonauts 2025 post-challenge leaderboard. Most-upvoted paper on Hugging Face on 20 October.
items.title: BrainLoRA adapts a 104B multimodal backbone to predict brain activity

items.summary: Black Forest Labs says the video model generates a 10-second clip in roughly 12 seconds, a 22x speed advantage over Seedance 2.5. Company-reported, no independent timing yet.
items.title: Black Forest Labs ships FLUX 3 Max, claiming a 10-second clip in about 12 seconds

items.summary: Notion says task duration rises from about five minutes to over a day, and that its Auto router cuts average cost by roughly 90%. It is a product-side datapoint on long-horizon agent economics alongside [[2026-10-20#5|CarryOn's 50% token reduction]].
items.title: Notion's sixth-generation agent harness runs single tasks for 24 hours or more

items.summary: Politico reports OpenAI has abandoned its lobbying for tighter controls on chip exports to China, which it ties to Nvidia's large investment relationship with the company; Anthropic continues to argue the opposite. It cuts against the tightening seen in [[2026-10-17#5|Taiwan's plan to criminalise unauthorised AI chip exports]] and [[2026-10-20#2|the DHS DeepSeek removal order]].
items.title: Politico: OpenAI drops its push for strict China chip export controls

lead: Google open-sourced TorchTPU, a native PyTorch backend for Cloud TPUs that replaces PyTorch/XLA, one day after AWS did the same for Trainium.
window: 20 Oct 07:00 → 21 Oct 07:00 JST (+ late catches from 19 Oct)
